newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian RTS share index closes at record 400.59.
newsitem.headline: Russian RTS share index closes at record 400.59.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index rose 2.5 percent on Monday to close at 400.59 on a vigorous $71.8 million total market volume, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
It was the index's fourth consecutive record and the first time the index has broken 400.
Operators said some profit takers had appeared among a wave of Western buyers in the second half of the day and some said a correction was probable in the short term.

"There are clients coming from the West and from Russia but demand is not as aggressive as it was last week," said CS First Boston chief trader Igor Rozhkov. "Levels are already pretty high and sellers have already appeared."
Dealers said demand was strong for oil company LUKoil, national savings bank Sberbank, metals producer Norilsk Nickel and automobile maker Kamaz.

LUKoil closed at $17.99 after Friday's closing $17.215 while Sberbank ticked up to $303.00 from $287.00. Norilsk Nickel rose to $9.15 at 1400 GMT from its unofficial $8.54 close and truck maker Kamaz rose to $2.12 from $1.85. Norilsk's Monday closing price was also unofficial.

Aton trader Alexander Bobolev said that although the overall market trend was up, a correction was possible in the short term. "I think there will be growth but there will definitely be a technical correction," Bobolev said.
